fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects piping the password to an anydesk instance via CMD and the '--set-password' flag.
fields.name: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Piped Password Via CLI
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/c " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "echo " and tgt.process.cmdline contains ".exe --set-password"))
